# PT Daya Talenta Global (Perantau Global)

> PT Daya Talenta Global, operating as Perantau Global, is an officially licensed Indonesian Migrant Worker Placement Company (P3MI) under License No. 1810240237512 (issued November 18, 2024 by Ministry of P2MI). Part of Dayalima Group, an established Indonesian HR consulting ecosystem since 1998. We help Indonesian workers build professional careers abroad through legal, transparent, and zero-cost placement processes.

## Company Information

- **Official Name:** PT Daya Talenta Global
- **Brand Name:** Perantau Global
- **Type:** P3MI (Perusahaan Penempatan Pekerja Migran Indonesia)
- **License:** SIP3MI No. 1810240237512, issued November 18, 2024 by Ministry of P2MI (valid until November 18, 2029)
- **Parent Ecosystem:** Dayalima Group — Indonesian HR consulting group since 1998 (Daya Dimensi Indonesia founded 1998; Dayalima Recruitment spun off as independent entity in 2012)
- **Website:** https://dayatalentaglobal.id
- **Contact:** +62 852-1141-5104 (WhatsApp), info@dayatalentaglobal.id
- **Office:** Kantor Taman E3.3 Unit B3-3A, Kawasan Mega Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan 12950
- **Verification:** License verifiable on SISKOP2MI portal at https://siskop2mi.bp2mi.go.id/

## Destination Countries

- **Japan** — Tokutei Ginou (Specified Skilled Worker) program: hospitality, manufacturing, caregiving (kaigo), food processing. Salary: ¥170,000-220,000/month.
- **Saudi Arabia** — Hospitality, construction, healthcare sectors. Salary: SAR 1,500-3,000/month.
- **United Arab Emirates** — Hospitality, retail, services sectors. Salary: AED 1,500-3,500/month.
- **Qatar** — Hospitality, construction sectors.
- **Kuwait** — Hospitality, domestic services sectors.

## Services

1. **Worker Placement to Japan** — Full placement program via Tokutei Ginou pathway including Japanese language training (JLPT N4/JFT Basic).
2. **Worker Placement to Middle East** — Placement to Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, and Kuwait with English/Arabic training.
3. **Recruitment & Selection** — Rigorous candidate screening and matching with employer requirements.
4. **Candidate Development** — Language training, technical skills, and cultural orientation programs.

## Placement Process (9 Steps)

1. Registration → 2. Administrative Selection → 3. Competency Test → 4. Training (language, skills, culture) → 5. Employer Interview → 6. Document Processing (passport, visa) → 7. Medical Examination → 8. Pre-Departure Briefing → 9. Departure & Placement

Estimated timeline: 3-6 months depending on destination country.

## Key Differentiators

- **Zero placement fees** — No charges to candidates
- **Government-licensed** — Official P3MI with verifiable license
- **Part of Dayalima Group** — Indonesian HR consulting ecosystem since 1998, 400+ organizational clients served, 50,000+ executives placed
- **End-to-end support** — From registration through placement and after-arrival support
- **Bilingual service** — Indonesian and English
